name: Tiroler Steinöl
description: Traditional Austrian shale oil products for health and wellness.
story: Tiroler Steinöl has been a staple in the Austrian Alps for generations, known for its unique medicinal properties. As a family-owned business deeply rooted in the region, we see motorsport as a perfect platform to showcase our commitment to performance and tradition. We seek a partnership that embodies Austrian spirit and achieves success on the global stage.
